name: arkivo
description: Open-source, self-hosted documentation hub for companies: import legacy docs (Word, PDF, PowerPoint), version history, AI chat and change proposals, MCP server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @arkivo/server" "npm run dev -w @arkivo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arkivo/server && npm run build -w @arkivo/web
